requirements_summary: Workload: chat/agent used inside product UI for guided flows. Latency SLO: streaming first-byte <150ms median, p95 end-to-end response <400ms for 2–4 turn exchanges. Throughput: 200 concurrent agents in peak region. Cost constraints: target < $0.75 per MAU/month (model+tokens), need monthly token caps and per-session hard token limit. Models: open variants OK, but must support tool-calling and structured streaming. Routing: prefer single-region routing with automatic fallback to cheaper model under load. Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS for keys, data residency in NA.
